Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo for withdrawal, which reads as under:
"It is submitted that the appellant has filed the above Criminal Appeal being aggrieved by the judgment of conviction dated 18.12.2018 and sentence dated 19.12.2018 passed in S.C No.41/2017 by the II Addl. District and Sessions Judge and Special Judge at Davanagere for the offence punishable under Sec.376 & 417 of Indian Penal Code and Sec.6 of the POCSO Act.
It is submitted that the appellant has undergone imprisonment and has paid the fine imposed on him by the II Addl. District and Sessions judge and Special Judge at Davanagere in S.C. No.41/2017 and he has been released from Shivamogga Central Prison on 03.03.2025.
The copy of the Release Certificate dated 03.03.2025 issued by the Chief Superintendent is produced herewith and marked as DOCUMENT No.1.

In light of the appellant having completed the sentence imposed on him, the appellant does not intend to prosecute the present criminal appeal and seeks to withdraw the same.
NC: 2025:KHC:44912 HC-KAR

WHEREFORE, it is most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Cout may be pleased to take the Memo for Withdrawal on record and pass appropriate orders, in the interest of justice and equity."
2.
Along with memo, the complainant has also produced Release Certificate issued by the Superintendent of Jail, Central Prison, Shivamogga and Aadhar Card of the appellant.

sentences.text: 3. In view of the memo, the appellant is permitted to withdraw this appeal.
4. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Registry is directed to send a copy of this order along with Trial Court Records to the concerned Court.
